_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: The system should ship axis space records, cell planning, axis-cell coverage binning, and a composite sampler that bins by axis cell then samples within a cell, so that set diversity is guaranteed by construction rather than only measured
requirements.title: Axis spaces and specified diversity

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:PS-P1-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should ship a test harness phase that validates a consuming scenario declarations when that scenario own suite runs, with a gated maturity ladder whose every rung declares a capability summary, whose every non-top rung declares its next unlock, and whose findings declare a clean requirement so a phase emitting nothing cannot report maximum maturity
requirements.title: Declaration conformance phase

requirements.description: The system should propose a new exemplar or anti-pattern from the difference between a generated candidate and the operator edited commit, for explicit confirmation, so the system learns the style without learning a preference ranking
